title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
summary: TechCrunch 援引《金融时报》称，Anthropic 将投入约 34 亿美元采购 Caterpillar 燃气发电机组，设备潜在发电能力达 1.7 吉瓦；交易安排细节由媒体转述，非公司公开证实。
investorNote: AI 算力瓶颈开始直接表现为电力设备锁单，但金额与实际交付还需追踪合同。

fact.subject: Anthropic
fact.object: 价值34亿美元的天然气发电设备

evidence.quote: AI’s power crunch has become so acute that Anthropic, a company that has generally avoided buying physical infrastructure, is spending $3.4 billion on natural gas turbines.

The AI company, which is planning to go public this year, is buying Caterpillar generators that equipment supplier OnePWR had originally ordered, according to a Financial Times report. The generators are capable of producing up to 1.7 gigawatts of electricity.

displayTitle: Anthropic 据报采购 34 亿美元燃气发电设备
narrative: TechCrunch 援引《金融时报》报道称，Anthropic 计划以约 34 亿美元锁定 Caterpillar 燃气发电设备，潜在规模达 1.7 吉瓦。这个数字来自媒体转述，不能当成已投运容量。它说明大型模型公司的算力采购正触及发电设备交期：谁先锁定电源，谁更可能守住数据中心扩张节奏；下一步应看合同、交付与并网进度。

eventRelation.reason: 本期报道的是发电设备采购，和同日模型发布是不同动作。
